body.message:
As per your request, please find the 4-month rates for the Upside Living 01 bedroom apartment

September: AED 7,000
October: AED 8,500
November: AED 12,000
December: AED 13,500

Please note that a security deposit of AED 3,000 is required. The booking will be on a monthly basis only (30 nights each month).

Thank you.
